scope: Deterministic development panel, not held-out release acceptance

cases.U6-01: Paid bounded forecasts change an affordable action; exact delivered and read surprise triggers paid investigation and U5 account revision; hypothetical records remain hypothetical.
cases.U6-02: Wait names an observation or assistance/resource condition; no busy polling; checkpoint retains unfinished reasoning, actions and pending intent; meaningful accessible delivery resumes work.
cases.U6-03: Pressure from outstanding demand, fear from processed threat, fatigue from charged work, scarcity from own finite wallet and processed resources, boredom from repeated observed outcomes affect declared decisions without awarding skill or development.

controls: forecast selection ablation with matched processing
hidden condition and hidden resource variants
wrong event actor target and context
finite budget exhaustion and no refunds
partial anticipation, partial Model A planning, partial action and exact restore
acquired procedure required for procedure candidate
all 16 type routes retain U5 regression coverage
rest lowers fatigue only; energy and time never replenish
actual request is paid; partner response not scripted by requester
stopped and waiting actors do not spin
raw independent accounting and tamper rejection
world_contract: u6.continuing-finite-workshop-v1 supplements unchanged u4.finite-workshop-v1; resting costs one energy and time quantum, lowers fatigue debt only, creates no energy, stock, skill or development.
policy_status: All dynamics, motivations, utility coefficients and prices added in U6 are engineering choices, not empirical psychological laws.
fresh_gates: U5 inherited 143-regression selection plus complete R14 autonomy tests with deduplication
